title: Financial reporting a few improvements
summary: Add improvements to financial reporting including a new action group for running reports and navigation from account lists to uncategorized accounts.
key_points: New 'Run report' action group added to financial reporting interface
Users can navigate from G/L Account List to accounts without category assignment
Save PDF from reporting packs with filename based on pack code
Changes applied across multiple localization layers (APAC, CH, ES, FR, W1)
New handler codeunit created for export filename management
